caption: The O(1) loop: a waking task joins the active array, the bitmap finds the highest-priority non-empty queue in one instruction, the task runs its timeslice and drops to the expired array, and the arrays swap when the active one empties.

spec.title: Linux O(1) runqueue
spec.aria: A loop in which a waking task joins the active array, the bitmap picks the highest-priority queue, the task runs for its timeslice, drops into the expired array, and the arrays are swapped when the active one empties.
